trajectory_summary: The call opens warm and stays cooperative throughout, with Randy volunteering financial strain, usage spikes, and EV plans unprompted. The rep runs the qualifier/verify sections competently and correctly redirects a technical EV-charger question to the specialist, but leaves the bill-pain and financial-strain disclosures unflipped and unacknowledged, and the bill document itself was never actually collected on the call. The appointment gets booked for a specific day and time, so despite some missed emotional leverage the call ends in forward motion.
